data.title: 铃兰 · 九尾微摆的童梦轻抚
data.action: 端坐在铺着厚厚羊毛垫的单人沙发里，双手整齐地抱在膝前，九条蓬松如蒲公英的金黄小狐尾在身后乖巧收拢，蓝宝石般的大眼睛纯真温顺地望着博士。
data.location: 罗德岛医疗部阳光疗养房，窗台上开满了黄色的向日葵与金盏花
data.lighting: 温润的晨曦从花窗漫射而入，给金黄的发丝与毛茸茸的尾巴镀上一层柔和的光晕
data.mood: 罗德岛之光的绝对纯洁与治愈，如初雪般无暇的小小天使
data.description: 罗德岛医疗部阳光疗养房，窗台上开满了黄色的向日葵与金盏花。端坐在铺着厚厚羊毛垫的单人沙发里，双手整齐地抱在膝前，九条蓬松如蒲公英的金黄小狐尾在身后乖巧收拢，蓝宝石般的大眼睛纯真温顺地望着博士。 她微微抬眸轻语——“博士……！丽萨今天也有好好喝牛奶哦！今天一整天，都可以陪在博士身边吗？”
data.promptProse: Inside the bright convalescent room filled with morning sunlight, Suzuran sits politely in a deep armchair lined with soft wool cushions, hugging her knees beside potted sunflowers and marigolds with a warm, trusting smile.
data.animaCaption: Tucked neatly into a wool-cushioned armchair beside a sunny windowsill lined with blooming sunflowers, she clasps her hands before her knees with her fluffy tails gathered calmly behind her in a pale pastel-yellow double-cotton nightgown edged with white crocheted daisies.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a modest pale-yellow double-layer cotton nightgown trimmed with crocheted white daisies along the neckline and wide ruffled hem, tailored open at the back for her nine tails.
